english.title: Make economic resources available for benefit of designated person - Ukraine
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being prohibited from doing so, without authority of a licence granted by the Treasury, you made economic resources available to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY ECONOMIC RESOURCES..), to a person namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), for the benefit of a designated person **(..SPECIFY DESIGNATED PERSON..), knowing or having reasonable cause to suspect that you were making such economic resources so available
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7(1), 10(1) and 12(1) of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

english.notes:
(i) Designated person means a person, entity or body listed in Annex I to the Council Regulation.
(ii) Financial benefit includes the discharge of a financial obligation for which the designated person is wholly or partly responsible for.
(iii) The offences does not apply to anything done under the authority of a licence granted by the Treasury. If a licence is revoked by the Treasury, the offence may still be made out as per regulation 9.
(iv) This offence may be committed by conduct wholly or partly outside the United Kingdom when it is conduct of a UK national or a body incorporated or constituted under the law of the United Kingdom.
(v) For the purpose of this offence, economic resources are made available for the benefit of a designated person only if that person obtains or is able to obtain, a significant financial benefit.
(vi) Proceedings for an offence under the regulations may not be instituted in England or Wales unless the consent of the Attorney General has been obtained. See regulation 14. This does not apply for summary offences.
(vii) For procedures regarding proceedings and jurisdiction, please see regulation 13.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and/or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes in to force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as reference to 6 months imprisonment.
